entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5666"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 21</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.21.1-Ps.21.13">Psa 21:1-13</reference>. The pious are led by the Psalmist to celebrate God's favor to the king in the already conferred and in prospective victories. The doxology added may relate to both Psalms; the preceding of petition, chiefly this of thanksgiving, ascribing honor to God for His display of grace and power to His Church in all ages, not only under David, but also under his last greatest successor, "the King of the Jews."</title> <div sID="gen8621" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5666"/><hi type="bold">1. thy strength ... thy salvation--</hi>as supplied by Thee. <div eID="gen8621" type="x-p"/>
